title: sorghum aethiopicum
intro: Sorghum aethiopicum, commonly known as durra, is a type of cereal crop belonging to the Sorghum genus. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, reducing inflammation, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Sorghum aethiopicum include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sorghum aethiopicum include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
